records.Name: SOW - Net Terms or Payment Terms
records.Content__c: Ensure that the "Net Terms" or "Payment " mentioned in the SOW (Statement of Work) are either 15 or 30.
records.Description__c: Net Terms or Payment Terms should be 15 or 30

records.Name: SOW - Billing Milestones - initial payment
records.Content__c: Ensure that Billing Milestones are present and that the initial payment upon SOW signature is at least 25%.

records.Name: SOW - Security Review dependency
records.Content__c: Ensure that Billing Milestones are present and that billing is not affected by security review results.
records.Description__c: Billing Milestones not contingent on Security Review

records.Name: SOW - Naming
records.Content__c: Verify that the client's full legal name is used in the first sentence, referred to as 'Client' throughout the document, and that both the client and Aquiva are properly named in the authorization section.

records.Name: SOW - Project Completion
records.Content__c: Check if the 'Project Completion' section is filled in and does not mention 'passing security review'.

records.Name: SOW - Description of Deliverables
records.Content__c: Verify that the 'Description of Deliverables' section contains content.

records.Name: SOW - Client Responsibilities
records.Content__c: Verify that the 'Client Responsibilities' section have content.

records.Name: SOW - Aquiva Deliverables
records.Content__c: Verify that the 'Aquiva Deliverables' section have content.

records.Name: SOW - Assumptions filled in
records.Content__c: Ensure that the "Assumptions" section is always filled with content and includes the required "Security Review assumption" for PDO-specific documents.

records.Name: SOW - Assumption tools
records.Content__c: Check if document includes the required assumptions regarding Aquiva's utilization of its Infrastructure, Tools, and Methodologies, and the right to replace personnel with resources of equal expertise.

records.Name: SOW - Assumptions for fixed fee
records.Content__c: Does the Statement of Work (SOW) include the required assumption about the fixed fee for a fixed price project?

records.Name: SOW - Planned Start Date
records.Content__c: The planned start date should be scheduled at least 14 days from the current date.
records.Description__c: Planned Start Date not in 2 weeks.

records.Name: SOW - No Renewal
records.Content__c: Document should not contain any language related to renewals, such as automatic renewal clauses or renewal terms.

records.Name: SOW - Net Terms or Payment Terms
records.Content__c: Ensure that the Net Terms or Payment Terms specify a 30-day period if billing in advance.
records.Description__c: Net Terms must be 30 if billing in advance

records.Name: SOW - Pricing for PTO
records.Content__c: Check the Pricing Section to ensure that the billing is always "in advance" when Paid Time Off (PTO) is included.
records.Description__c: Pricing Section for Billing and PTO

records.Name: SOW - PTO pricing in advanced billing
records.Content__c: Ensure that the following paragraph is included when addressing billing in advance (including PTO): "For services billed in advance, the invoice will include the agreed-upon fees for the upcoming billing period, as well as any applicable charges for paid time off (PTO). The client is responsible for paying the invoice in full before the start of the billing period."
records.Description__c: Pricing Section for Advance Billing with PTO inclusion

records.Name: SOW - Pricing Section for no PTO
records.Content__c: Ensure that the billing is always in arrears when Paid Time Off (PTO) is NOT included.
records.Description__c: Pricing Section when PTO not included

records.Name: SOW - Billing in advance for no PTO
records.Content__c: Ensure that the paragraph includes information about billing in advance and does not mention Paid Time Off (PTO).
records.Description__c: Pricing Section for for Advance Billing without PTO

records.Name: SOW - Cancellation Clause
records.Content__c: Ensure that there are no specific cancellation terms mentioned.

records.Name: SOW - Renewal Clause
records.Content__c: Ensure that the section about renewal is present and contains text regarding automatic renewal and resource rate increase limits.

records.Name: SOW - Capacity Based SOW Sections
records.Content__c:
"Ensure that the document includes all listed sections:
1. Name and Description of Project
2. Description of Deliverables and Project Scope
3. Pricing: Managed Services Delivery
4. Terms of Engagement and Payment Schedule
5. Project Start/Project  Schedule
6. Renewal
7.  Assumptions: 
8. Project Delays
9. User Acceptance Testing (UAT)"

records.Name: SOW - Team resize
records.Content__c: The document should contain a section that clearly states that either party can re-size the team with a 90 days notice and the changes are limited to 15% of the current team size or total monthly price.

records.Name: SOW - Start date should not be defined
records.Content__c: Ensure that in the document there is no specific planned start date.

records.Name: SOW - Scope and Responsibilities
records.Content__c: Verify that the 'Scope and Responsibilities' section contains content.
